title: Normalized solutions for a class of fractional Choquard equations with the HLS lower critical term and a nonlocal perturbation
summary: In this paper, we study the mass-constrained fractional Choquard equation \( (-Δ)^s u = λu + α(I_μ* |u|^{\frac{2N-μ}{N}})|u|^{\frac{2N-μ}{N}-2}u + (I_μ* |u|^p)|u|^{p-2}u \) in \( \mathbb{R}^N \), under the constraint \( \int_{\mathbb{R}^N} |u|^2 \, dx = c^2 > 0 \), where \( N > 2s \), \( s \in (0,1) \), \( μ\in (0,N) \), \( α> 0 \), and \( 2 + \frac{2s-μ}{N} \le p < \frac{2N-μ}{N-2s} \). We first establish a nonexistence result in the \( L^2 \)-critical case \( p = 2 + \frac{2s-μ}{N} \).
